kv1.4:1.3: Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dukkhadassanena kiṃ jahatīti?
kv1.4:1.4: Sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ vicikicchaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese ekadese jahatīti.

kv1.4:1.7: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato, ekadesaṃ ariyakantehi sīlehi na samannāgato ti?
kv1.4:2.2: Sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ jahati, vicikicchaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese ekadese jahatīti.
kv1.4:2.4: ekadesaṃ ariyakantehi sīlehi na samannāgato ti? Na
